# llm.image/v1

A model makes pictures from a prompt, or changes the pictures it's given. They come back as files. Every call names its model as `provider/model`: a provider the app's admins added in Settings → LLM, a slash, and
that provider's own id for the model. Shared types (`File`, `Usage`, `ModelInfo`, `Job`, the errors) are in
[`pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/llm`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/blob/main/ext/contracts/llm/llm.go).

A wire contract at `/api/_c/llm.image/v1` ([image.go](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/blob/main/ext/contracts/llm/image/v1/image.go)), one provider. The
[llm](/docs/extensions/llm/extension) extension provides it, over Vultr, Cloudflare Workers AI, OpenRouter and any
OpenAI-compatible API.

## Use

In page code it's `$llm.image` (bound by the llm extension):

```js
const r = await $llm.image.generateAsync({ model: "vultr/z-image-turbo", prompt: "a lighthouse at dusk, watercolor", aspectRatio: "16:9" })
record.set("cover", $llm.file(r.files[0]))
```

Over HTTP (a superuser, or a token with the scope shown):

| Operation | HTTP | Body | Token scope |
|---|---|---|---|
| Generate | `POST /api/_c/llm.image/v1/generate` | `{"model": "...", "prompt": "...", "n": 1, "size": "1024x1024"}` | `llm` |
| Edit | `POST /api/_c/llm.image/v1/edit` | as Generate, with `"images": [File]` | `llm` |
| Models | `GET /api/_c/llm.image/v1/models` | `?provider=` (optional) | `llm:read` |

Both answer `{"files": [File], "model", "usage"}`. A `File` is `{"name", "type", "data", "url"}`: `data` is the bytes
(base64), `url` the provider's own copy when it keeps one.

Errors: `not_configured` (no providers), `unknown_model`, `not_supported`, `provider` (the cloud's own error), `timeout`.

From Go: `imagev1.Contract.Must(app)` (from `pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/llm/image/v1`).

## Provide

Implement `imagev1.Image` and provide it in `Register` (`imagev1.Contract.Provide(app, impl)`). Route on the
`provider/` prefix, answer `not_supported` for a provider that can't do this kind, `unknown_model` for a missing model
or provider, and `provider` with the cloud's own message (never its key) when the cloud refuses. Fill `model` with the
full `provider/model` that answered, and `usage` with what the provider reports.

## Commands and APIs

Every operation is a REST endpoint, a `pocketone` command and an MCP tool, all generated from the contract and behind the same token scope check and hooks. See [Remote CLI](/docs/features/remote), or the full [CLI](/docs/reference/cli), [REST](/docs/reference/rest) and [MCP](/docs/reference/mcp) references.

### generate

Makes pictures from a prompt.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/_c/llm.image/v1/generate` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote llm image generate --model <value> --prompt <value> --n <n> --size <value> --aspectratio <value> --options <json>` |
| MCP | `llm_image_generate` |
| Token scope | `llm` |

| Input field | Flag | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `model` | `--model` | string |
| `prompt` | `--prompt` | string |
| `n` | `--n` | int |
| `size` | `--size` | string |
| `aspectRatio` | `--aspectratio` | string |
| `options` | `--options` | json |

### edit

Changes the pictures it's given as the prompt says.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `POST /api/_c/llm.image/v1/edit` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote llm image edit --generateinput <json> --images <json>` |
| MCP | `llm_image_edit` |
| Token scope | `llm` |

| Input field | Flag | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `GenerateInput` | `--generateinput` | json |
| `images` | `--images` | json |

### models

Lists the image models of every provider in Settings → LLM.

| | |
|---|---|
| REST | `GET /api/_c/llm.image/v1/models` |
| CLI | `pocketone remote llm image models --provider <value>` |
| MCP | `llm_image_models` |
| Token scope | `llm:read` |

| Input field | Flag | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` | `--provider` | string |
